+from openlibrary.catalog.merge.normalize import normalize as normalize_title
+
+
+re_amazon_title_paren = re.compile(r'^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')
+
+
+def build_titles(title: str) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Create normalized and alternative title forms for edition matching."""
+    normalized_title = normalize_title(title).lower()
+    titles = [title, normalized_title]
+    if ' & ' in title:
+        alternate = title.replace(' & ', ' and ')
+        titles.extend((alternate, normalize_title(alternate)))
+    for candidate in titles[:]:
+        if candidate.lower().startswith('the '):
+            titles.append(candidate[4:])
+        elif candidate.lower().startswith('a '):
+            titles.append(candidate[2:])
+    if re_amazon_title_paren.match(title):
+        for candidate in titles[:]:
+            if match := re_amazon_title_paren.match(candidate):
+                titles.extend((match.group(1), normalize_title(match.group(1))))
+    return {
+        'full_title': title,
+        'normalized_title': normalized_title,
+        'titles': titles,
+        'short_title': normalized_title[:25],
+    }
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Expand an edition record into title variants and combined ISBNs for matching."""
+    expanded = build_titles(rec['full_title'])
+    isbn = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        isbn.extend(rec.get(field, []))
+    expanded['isbn'] = isbn
+    if rec.get('publish_country') not in (None, '   ', '|||'):
+        expanded['publish_country'] = rec['publish_country']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+    ):
+        if field in rec:
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+    return expanded
